$$\tau(n) = (a_1 + 1)(a_2 + 1)...(a_k + 1)$$

For your bunny's bouquet with $2^4 \cdot 3^3 \cdot 5^2 \cdot 7^2$:

$$\tau(n) = (4+1)(3+1)(2+1)(2+1) = 5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 3 = 180$$
